content: better-auth's genericOAuth/OIDC plugin authenticates against any OIDC provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Azure AD). To default new SSO-provisioned users to a given role, the SSO/organizationProvisioning config exposes a defaultRole option (e.g. 'member') and an optional getRole(user) callback for custom logic — this is the mechanism to satisfy 'new OIDC users get role member'.
